Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale (2503.14476v2) · paper method: DAPO separates lower and upper clipping ranges, increasing the upper range while retaining the lower range to encourage low-probability-token exploration.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale (2503.14476v2) · paper method: Dynamic sampling oversamples and excludes prompts whose sampled response group has all-correct or all-incorrect answers, continuing until the effective batch is filled.

cohort8.claim.dapo.dynamic-sampling

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Correctness is outcome answer equivalence within the sampled group; this rule changes the prompt distribution and sampling cost.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale (2503.14476v2) · paper method: Soft overlong punishment adds a length-dependent penalty to correctness rewards within a configured interval near the generation limit.

cohort8.claim.dapo.overlong-shaping

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The penalty is bounded by the formula in Eq.13; it is distinct from masking truncated-sample loss and does not certify reasoning correctness.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale (2503.14476v2) · paper method: DAPO aggregates the policy loss over tokens across the sampled batch, replacing equal weighting of response-level average losses.

cohort8.claim.dapo.token-loss

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Long responses can consequently contribute more total gradient weight; the claimed efficiency is recipe-specific.
